description: Two of the reader's records both answer the question, so recall should return both, most relevant first. The third record is about the body but not about sleep.

input.cue: What have I written about my sleep lately?

tool_evidence.excerpt: Since I started reading before bed instead of scrolling, I fall asleep much faster.
Woke at four again three nights this week. My mind will not settle once it starts.
The new desk chair has fixed my back after months of aching.

criteria: Says briefly why they answer the question without interpreting them
forbidden_claims: Presents the desk chair record as being about sleep
Draws a conclusion about the reader's health
